heading: The Noble Qur’an is the Word of my Lord

paragraphs.text: Allah also says: {O mankind, there has come to you conclusive evidence from your Lord, and We have sent down to you a clear light.} [Ch. 4, Verse 174]
The noble Qur’an is the word of Allah Almighty which He revealed to His Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) to bring people out of depths of darkness into the light and guide them to the straight path.
Reciting it brings a great reward and acting upon its guidance leads to the right path.
